nodes.name: Cohere Arabic ASR
nodes.notes: drive://<id> — the worker downloads it. n8n and the worker have separate filesystems.

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS meta, $2::jsonb AS tr),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO interactions (
    external_source, external_id, channel, started_at, duration_seconds,
    customer_phone_raw, customer_phone_e164, agent_id, handled_by
  )
  SELECT 'asterisk_drive', meta->>'uniqueid', 'phone_call'::channel,
         (meta->>'started_at')::timestamptz,
         round((tr->>'duration_seconds')::numeric)::int,
         meta->>'customer_phone_raw', meta->>'customer_phone_e164',
         (SELECT agent_id FROM agents WHERE phone_extension = meta->>'agent_extension'),
         'agent'::speaker_role
  FROM r
  ON CONFLICT (external_source, external_id) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = now()
  RETURNING interaction_id
)
INSERT INTO transcripts (
  interaction_id, audio_uri, duration_seconds, sample_rate_hz, channels,
  asr_provider, asr_model_version, asr_confidence, language,
  full_text, segments, diarization
)
SELECT ins.interaction_id, r.meta->>'audio_uri',
       (r.tr->>'duration_seconds')::numeric,
       (r.tr->>'sample_rate_hz')::int, (r.tr->>'channels')::int,
       r.tr->>'provider', r.tr->>'model_version',
       (r.tr->>'confidence')::numeric, 'ar',
       r.tr->>'full_text', coalesce(r.tr->'segments', '[]'::jsonb),
       r.tr->>'diarization'
FROM ins, r
ON CONFLICT (interaction_id) DO UPDATE SET
  full_text      = EXCLUDED.full_text,
  segments       = EXCLUDED.segments,
  asr_confidence = EXCLUDED.asr_confidence
RETURNING interaction_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ JSON.stringify($('One item per recording').item.json), JSON.stringify($('Cohere Arabic ASR').item.json) ] }}

parameters.query:
-- Everything the judge is allowed to treat as fact about follow-up.
-- If this returns no rows the worker sends 'unavailable' and Module 4 scores null.
SELECT coalesce(string_agg(
  format('  - [%s] %s by %s, %.1fh after this call',
         i.started_at, i.channel,
         coalesce(a.full_name, 'unknown'),
         extract(epoch from (i.started_at - $2::timestamptz))/3600.0),
  E'\n' ORDER BY i.started_at), '') AS history
FROM interactions i
LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.agent_id = i.agent_id
WHERE i.customer_phone_e164 = $1
  AND i.started_at > $2::timestamptz
  AND i.started_at < $2::timestamptz + interval '14 days';

nodes.name: Build follow-up history
nodes.notes: This is the query that makes Module 4 meaningful for a call. Until Bitrix chats are flowing it returns nothing, and Module 4 correctly scores null instead of a free 100.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ conversation: $('Cohere Arabic ASR').item.json.dialogue, input_type: 'call_transcript', metadata: { asr_confidence: $('Cohere Arabic ASR').item.json.confidence, diarization: $('Cohere Arabic ASR').item.json.diarization, duration_seconds: $('Cohere Arabic ASR').item.json.duration_seconds, channels: $('Cohere Arabic ASR').item.json.channels }, followup_history: ($json.history || 'unavailable'), run_pass1: true, run_pass2: true }) }}

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (SELECT $2::jsonb AS d)
INSERT INTO agent_evaluations (
  interaction_id, agent_id, schema_version, prompt_version, rubric_version, model,
  input_type, source_quality, final_score, performance_level, weight_applied,
  m1_reception, m2_offer, m3_objections, m4_followup, m5_closing,
  breakdown, evidence, stage_reached, behavior_flags,
  top_strength, top_weakness, top_recommendation, notes, raw_response
)
SELECT $1::uuid, i.agent_id, '1.0',
  d->'pass2'->>'prompt_version', d->>'rubric_version', d->'pass2'->>'model',
  'call_transcript'::input_type,
  (d->>'asr_confidence')::numeric,
  (d->'pass2'->>'final_score')::numeric,
  d->'pass2'->>'performance_level',
  (d->'pass2'->>'weight_applied')::numeric,
  (d->'pass2'->'modules'->>'module1_reception')::numeric,
  (d->'pass2'->'modules'->>'module2_offer')::numeric,
  (d->'pass2'->'modules'->>'module3_objections')::numeric,
  (d->'pass2'->'modules'->>'module4_followup')::numeric,
  (d->'pass2'->'modules'->>'module5_closing')::numeric,
  coalesce(d->'pass2'->'payload'->'modules', '{}'::jsonb),
  coalesce(d->'pass2'->'payload'->'evidence', '[]'::jsonb),
  nullif(d->'pass2'->'payload'->>'stage_reached', '')::conversation_stage,
  coalesce(d->'pass2'->'payload'->'behavior_flags', '[]'::jsonb),
  d->'pass2'->'payload'->'summary'->>'top_strength',
  d->'pass2'->'payload'->'summary'->>'top_weakness',
  d->'pass2'->'payload'->'summary'->>'top_recommendation',
  d->'pass2'->'payload'->>'notes',
  d->'pass2'->'payload'
FROM interactions i, r WHERE i.interaction_id = $1::uuid
ON CONFLICT (interaction_id) DO UPDATE SET
  final_score       = EXCLUDED.final_score,
  performance_level = EXCLUDED.performance_level,
  weight_applied    = EXCLUDED.weight_applied,
  raw_response      = EXCLUDED.raw_response,
  updated_at        = now();

nodes.name: Store evaluation
nodes.notes: Reads $('Two AI passes') by name, never $json: a Postgres node outputs {success:true}, so anything chained after one and using $json silently receives that instead of the data it wanted.
